title: Context Travels With Me
style: world electronic, 110 BPM, traveller energy, global multilingual vibe, male vocal warm and mobile, context portability theme, ZYNCONTEXT as travel companion, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Perth to Nicaragua — context intact
Every city, every time zone — on track
MOSOKO voice on the plane
ZYNCONTEXT holds the chain
Ten languages — one layer
Every session — the same player
New device — same history
Context travels — no mystery

[CHORUS]
Context travels with me
Wherever I go — it's there
Context travels with me
New country — same thread — same care
Context travels with me
ZYNCONTEXT on the road
Context travels with me
The layer carries the load

[OUTRO]
Travels with me. Always. ZYNCONTEXT.
